pattern.description: The AI agent's reply bubble and its avatar pop into the chat panel below the customer message and drift up a short distance while settling; the product card row begins to rise in beneath at the end.
pattern.why_premium: Reply arrives as one unit (avatar plus bubble) with a soft scale-and-rise that decelerates over about half a second, mimicking real chat arrival; the next content (product cards) is chained right after so the conversation keeps momentum.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo([avatar, bubble], {autoAlpha: 0, scale: 0.85, y: 40}, {autoAlpha: 1, scale: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power3.out', stagger: 0.03}); tl.fromTo(cards, {autoAlpha: 0, y: 30}, {autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.06}, '-=0.05').
build_hint.remotion: const s = spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}); bubble and avatar: opacity s, scale interpolate(s,[0,1],[0.85,1]), translateY interpolate(s,[0,1],[40,0]); cards use the same spring with delay ~30 frames and per-card stagger 2 frames.

notes: Filmstrip frames are a zoomed crop of the reply area. b01 is a union of bubble plus avatar and is not used to avoid double-counting. Product cards only start entering at the burst end (likely the next event). SFX candidates look like music beats.
